verdict.rationale: Clara is a SaaS spend platform, so headless automation means driving it through its API. The docs claim programmatic control of every aspect of the platform (cards, transactions, users, invoices) via the API. API credentials are self-managed from the dashboard, and a sandbox lets you test integrations end-to-end without triggering real financial operations, which suits CI. Runnable mTLS client examples and an OpenAPI schema support unattended scripted use. Missing for 10: no official CLI or explicit CI/pipeline guidance, no documented non-interactive service-account or credential-rotation workflow for CI, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of headless use.
